title: stegostyla iridescens
intro: Stegostyla iridescens, commonly known as the "Iridescent Moonflower", is a species of flowering plant in the family Asclepiadaceae. It is known for its vibrant and iridescent flowers that bloom at night, emitting a strong fragrance to attract pollinators. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and treating respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Stegostyla iridescens include iridoid glycosides, which have been shown to have therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
